title: Contract nine native helper outputs at conditional κ 0.00315057
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Contract nine native helper outputs on PR6349's supplier by a joint input and departure basis in the transpose. Nine zero temporary rows permit later insertion of independent input directions; paid native transports and both inverse bases restore the complete endpoint. The final forward word keeps all 770 public inputs independent and all original input frames.

The complete author-checked conditional claim is **κ = 0.00315057**, up **0.00000077 (0.0244%)** from PR6350's released composition at 0.00314980. This is a small gain; the donor's large-breakthrough target remains unmet. The new raw crossing lies strictly in **(0.00315058201488, 0.00315058201489)**. The old supplier with this same fixed caller fails at the new claim.

With `H_r = r^(1-kappa)`, the exact changes per local call are:

```text
paid:       14H1 - 4H2 - 3H3 + 4H4 - 5H5
productive: H5 + 8H8 - 9H9
```

Both local rank masses decrease by twelve. Paid calls increase by six. All nineteen copies of both changes are included. The unchanged PR6348 tree has **70,656 paid jobs, 14,214 productive jobs and rank-mass surplus 808**. The word has 17,657 events, 29 owned labels, 41 owned lifetimes and peak storage 13. No owned field receives productive credit.

Only `research/p104-joint-output-contraction/` is added. The selected frontier is unchanged. All five inherited framework assumptions remain. No materialized uniform word, rounded multiplier, practical speedup, independent scientific acceptance or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.

Canonical base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8. Publication head: `db2a20bc50bc7a8a4db931af85ce7f012ae7c3c3`. Task `p104-side-correction`; the changed source, boundary and joint-basis scope are explicit in TASK.json.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645#discussioncomment-19205459). The current private terminal-contact/causal-history work in Discussion5600 and spectator-axis work in Discussion5593 are excluded. Direct claims and recent open PRs were refreshed. Cached remote pagination is complete; sparse local notes, arbitrary unseen diffs and unpublished work remain limits.

PR6349 at `af7cb6c67f8fc7d82a2e4aee2dd2f07481bf6690` supplies the exact native word. PR6348 at `9894015d6f380206f990ad5fd14bc49bbd26b0d0` supplies the fixed tree. Both are in main. PR6350 at `466c812fe729ed540265eeaeabc5e4a71d3440c5` publishes their released composition. This package recounts that control from main and does not import pending PR6350 code or claim its composition as new.

## Validation

On CPython 3.12.13, macOS 26.6.1 arm64:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-joint-output-contraction
```

Both normal and optimized registered replays pass. They check source pins, every regenerated word byte, joint basis identities, exact zero temporary rows, all 799 scalar columns, a separate dense transpose, 2,932 native maps with absolute phases, 7,904 caller contacts, the complete signed bill, two rational price engines, completion/compiler bounds and all 54 strict plus four functional outer predicates. All 26 explicit controls reject. The retained native-phase and price controls also pass.

Committed bytes and executable modes pass for all 28 package/input files. The official export covers all thirteen live inputs. The complete normal and optimized export replays pass with empty PATH and OS-enforced write protection. All 29 exported files and their modes stay unchanged. Actual source-word and price-literal mutations reject. The validation record gives the exact tested scientific commit and environment.

The broad concave-tariff preflight is inconclusive; no uniform concave-tariff improvement is claimed. The exact moment calculation at the declared saving supplies the price evidence. The optional full source-history preflight stops because this checkout is shallow. All pins resolve at the canonical base, which is the scientific commit's direct parent. Full history was not fetched. [Hosted CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41385586837) passed at head `db2a20bc50bc7a8a4db931af85ce7f012ae7c3c3` on CPython 3.12.15. The job log contains both complete scientific PASS markers and the registered-package PASS. The committed-input preservation step also passed. This is hosted replay, not independent scientific acceptance.
